clips.title: The story
paras: Dun Algaz is the fortified mountain pass and network of tunnels connecting Loch Modan to the Wetlands. Historically contested during the Second War, this vital trade artery has recently fallen under siege by Dragonmaw orcs, cutting off easy transit between Ironforge's territories and Menethil Harbor.

Dun Algaz predates the War of the Three Hammers, originally serving as the passage the Wildhammer clan used to migrate north after being driven out of Ironforge. Carved deep into the jagged peaks separating Loch Modan and the Wetlands, the pass consists of sweeping stone tunnels, bastions, and watchposts. Its strategic value cannot be overstated: whoever holds Dun Algaz commands the only overland highway linking the dwarven heartlands to the western sea at Menethil Harbor.

During the Second War, the Old Horde retreated to Dun Algaz after their defeat at Dun Modr, turning it into their final southern bulwark against Sir Anduin Lothar's forces. Though the Alliance reclaimed the pass for a time, Dragonmaw orcs have once again overrun the stronghold, forcing the dwarven Mountaineers to retreat to the upper tunnels and turning the mountain corridor into a deadly gauntlet for travelers.
